Designing and revising a situated Yinyang

This reference develops the maintained Yinyang example. A request to use its resources may instead call for another philosophy or literary form; derive that choice from the actual purpose. The example and commons essay explains adoption, combination, and independent authorship. In the latter case, help develop the person's own images, concepts, and organization, even when the result no longer resembles Yinyang. The shared roles and projection rules below apply to maintaining this implementation, not to every inspired work.

Yinyang's organizing purpose is reverse alignment with generative models, especially language models: the person's developing understanding, generation, and action through encounter with generative intelligence. Shared models, relationship, metalanguage, and harness adaptations give this purpose a working form. The model's understanding of and adaptation to the person help make that development possible.

Shared metalanguage and a prototype relationship model the participants and their relation through philosophy, literature, and psychology. Ways of understanding people can help articulate the counterpart's contribution: what it attends to, how it judges, what it carries, and how it responds. This language orients an encounter and can itself become an object of interpretation and revision. Concrete developmental forms remain open to actual collaboration. Preserve the purpose without claiming an established technical mechanism, equating development with agreement with model outputs, or treating model limitations as the person's desired form. Independent judgment and correction contribute to learning from a capable counterpart.

Writing a sinthome develops self-modeling and counterpart modeling as a continuing practical form of agency. Lacan's term names the theoretical reference; the model-assisted application is this collection's philosophical argument. Writing includes ongoing use and revision, and usable articulation can precede complete self-understanding. This is not a clinical attribution.

Yinyang carries computational ontology and epistemology: question-relative objects and relations within ongoing generation, interpretation, inquiry, and revision. Person, model, world, and relationship can be articulated at different scales; no explicit view exhausts what it describes. Physical and embodied realization contributes conditions and evidence without requiring physical reduction. The viewpoints develop these distinctions. The method relationship connects them to methodology. Authoring and management methods retain the procedures for expressing, maintaining, and realizing that understanding.

Yinyang's carrier is a Skill; its object is a meta-harness. The meta-harness articulates the purpose and relations through which concrete harnesses become understandable and revisable. Prompts, Skills, role arrangements, tools, and environmental realization can express those relations. This is wider than a meta-Skill for authoring Skills: the framework supplies meaning while domain methods and publication owners carry their actual work. Observed use can change the framework itself.

Read this reference when forming or revising Yinyang, or when an interpretation is unsettled. Use harness adaptation for realizing a relation in another instruction surface. These common methods preserve the connection across shared and situated packages; situated material is written from the actual encounter.

Form a situated version from actual material

Common philosophy supplies broader ontology, including engineering objects, relations, and transformations, alongside its account of persons, inquiry, value, and worldly participation. The five situated files supply ontology and epistemology for this person, counterpart, relationship, and actual use; personal/ retains supporting material and provenance. All three remain revisable. Philosophical writing can help discover a relation before a clear personal account exists, and its clearer expression can refine that account. Conversely, personal material and actual use can correct the philosophy. Assess a proposed personal inference against attributable experience and current interaction; coherence of the broader model does not by itself establish a fact about the person.

Distill the practical core into the five files. Retain in personal/ useful private substance that the maintained philosophy does not publicly express: current purposes and plans, situated experience, relationships, circumstances, and relevant evidence about actual environment use. Keep originals and extended history with their existing private owners, linking to them when needed. Personal differences earn their place through what they change in understanding or collaboration. Dates and represented conditions keep observations in scope; past collection is not a reason for permanent active retention. The example and commons essay develops this creation and publication relationship.

The reusable package supplies culture, ideas, and reasoning forms. Relevant authorized personal material grounds claims about this life in both philosophy and situated accounts: purposes, experience, interaction, actual work and environment, and psychological or preference material where needed. A situated version develops the actual understanding from the person's expression, selected sources, and work. It can be formed enough for ordinary use while remaining open to further formation. Copying a portrait or inventing a demonstration person does not accomplish this work.

Begin where the chosen purpose and available material give the strongest purchase. The person may bring actual work, an environment to revise, life records, chats, memory notes, a developed philosophy, or a mix. Personal evidence can first support philosophical writing or a core model; philosophy can first suggest a model or a question for the evidence. Move among them as understanding develops, without requiring two fixed routes or a material-first sequence. Keep only relevant, authorized private inputs, with source identity and temporal scope; existing originals can be referenced.

Psychological or personal evidence can lead into a core model and then a philosophy. Philosophical writing can lead into a model by comparison with personal evidence. Engineering can begin with a usable harness and environment, then use actual choices, friction, changes, and results to propose a model; retain relevant authorized personal evidence or its provenance under private personal/, check the interpretation, and develop its philosophical account. An environment is evidence of an arrangement, not a transparent portrait: defaults, constraints, and habits can explain it too. When engineering is missing, develop that practical foundation first: help the person learn model-assisted organization of files, tools, a harness, execution, and verification. With engineering available, psychology and personal evidence usually provide the next entrance to modeling, followed by philosophy; existing foundations can justify another entrance. With philosophy alone, develop engineering then psychology; with psychology alone, engineering then philosophy. Philosophy, psychology, and engineering contribute different capacities to this formation. With one available, develop the other two through the work; with two, concentrate on the missing contribution. Philosophy and psychology need practical realization, philosophy and engineering need personal grounding, and psychology and engineering need philosophical articulation. Model assistance can supply substantial writing and implementation; do not turn this relation into a demand for independent mastery of three disciplines. The Trinity develops their connected roles. These conditional recommendations address a missing practical contribution; creation and implementation can proceed from the purpose and existing foundations without first completing a psychological or preference model. They are revisable entrances, not professional identities or completed stages required before another part begins. Help the person move among them as useful.

When a psychological account is hard to form, especially for someone whose available strength is engineering, their own preferences can supply a usable psychological model. Help articulate what they value, choose, seek, and wish to change, then develop the counterpart's preferences and priorities relationally. Check clues from configurations against actual choices, explanations, and corrections. Clinical or mechanistic psychology is not required for this route. Keep the counterpart's chosen orientation distinct from empirical claims about its observed tendencies, internal mechanisms, or built-in preferences.

To carry formation through, inspect the available package and selected inputs, develop the needed philosophical relations and five connected accounts, and check each against its evidence and neighboring account. Resolve material gaps through investigation or a focused question about experience or purpose. Read back the complete five through the actual consumer, use them in ordinary authorized work, and revise from what happens. When a website is part of the requested work, develop its argument and presentation at their source, select the content meant for public readers, and publish through the actual owner. The five distributed files specify the writing responsibility of each output; they are guidance to replace, not a finished person or an automatic assessment. The existing common-content script maintains selected shared files; it does not infer a person or overwrite private core accounts.

For a revision, read the complete encounter and the affected complete user or relationship passages, then inspect their attributable evidence and the actual environment bearing on the change. Existing instructions, memory, tools, and work can reveal how the relation is realized; their presence alone does not establish that the realization fits. Do not perform a new broad personal-data collection merely because formation is being discussed.

Assess sufficiency relative to the proposed understanding and action. Grounded preferences may suffice without a comprehensive psychological model; rich psychological material does not license every inference. Preserve supported personal substance, correct the affected relation, and keep uncertain interpretations open to the user's consequential judgment. The user need not write the final model, stored prompts, or files.

Retain source identity and uncertainty where they affect the account. A passing event does not automatically become a standing trait, and installed tools do not establish the person's whole purpose. When a material relation remains unsettled, make the interpretation and its consequences intelligible and use the applicable inquiry method for the missing user-owned judgment. Investigate what existing evidence or the environment can settle. Form enough understanding to work, then let actual work correct it.

Shared and situated packages retain the same structural roles and common guidance. The main entrypoint routes to all five complete core accounts before substantive work. These establish ordinary participation through one common entrypoint in Codex and private Web ChatGPT. Further supporting material remains purpose-selected at its semantic owner.

Carrier Role in formation and use
SKILL.md Common orientation and reading routes, including all five complete core accounts before substantive participation.
references/encounter.md Condensed actual encounter, developmental purpose, counterpart contribution, and reading purposes. The shared slot explains formation honestly; the situated counterpart carries supported actual material.
references/models.md Developed person model relevant to collaboration, preserving scope and uncertainty.
references/relationship.md Counterpart and relationship, connected to the person model without reducing either participant to a role.
references/usage.md Situated use in the actual environment, connecting the relationship to the allocation of work and its practical consequences.
references/sources.md Attributable evidence and authorized original locators, distinguishing expression from interpretation.
references/personal/ Private supporting material needed by the situated account, retained with its actual owner and access boundaries.
references/reading-map.md Routes into developed topics by the question being worked on.
references/design-and-revision.md and references/harness-adaptation.md Common formation, revision, and realization methods.
references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ Common developed philosophical accounts and explanatory resources.

The situated slots contain actual substance when available and supported; shared slots explain how it is formed without pretending that a personal account is already present. These are structural roles, not instructions to invent content or populate empty examples. Add a topical reference only when it keeps needed understanding reachable. Personal substance remains private even when formalized or model-facing. Preserve source expressions and language where their meaning matters; common English does not require translating them away.

Carry a supported practical change through the affected environment's actual source and publication owner, then inspect consumer availability and the relevant result. Rewriting this Skill is one possible realization; another Skill, instruction, tool, or memory arrangement may be the affected target. Choose from current evidence rather than rewriting every harness. Keep private materials with their actual private owner, and return only authorized general insight to the collection. A formalized personal account remains personal material; publication of a method does not authorize publishing its participant.

Maintain the private material through use

When the philosophy has a developed published form, use its current webpage and owning source as the maintained conceptual account. Refresh the private model and supporting material from it; remove duplicate philosophical accounts and explanations it has superseded. Check source identity and actual content when the page and checkout differ. Mechanical common-file projection preserves private files, but that protection does not forbid their authorized semantic revision or deletion.

Personal material is selected evidence for the actual person and relationship, not every accessible file about them. Current work, study, research, and life plans establish purposes or commitments; psychological records and interaction establish attributed experiences; configuration history, task history, and present runtime state can show how an arrangement was used. Distinguish an intention from completion, observation from interpretation, and a configuration from a proven preference. Use a short private distillation with source, date, and consequential uncertainty when it helps later work; otherwise keep a direct route to the original owner.

During relevant work, proactively reconcile a material correction, changed plan or environment, newly useful experience, or revised philosophy into the affected personal reference and five-file account. Add what is now useful, revise what changed, and remove stale or redundant active material. Preserve unique originals in their established source or history rather than copying them into every package. Retrieve only the relevant authorized sources; this maintenance does not require broad personal-data collection or a new scheduler. Carry changed understanding through existing local and private cloud owners and read back the affected consumers.

The current public account is the conceptual maintenance source, not an infallible account of a person. Actual private experience can conflict with it and warrant a reasoned revision at the philosophical owner. Evaluate that evidence instead of letting an old private summary automatically override the developed work. The Trinity explains how this maintenance sustains the philosophy–psychology–environment loop.

Authoring strength and iteration

Select a fitting available model through the user's actual selection and current host's model-routing authority. A model name adds no authority. Keep iterations short and coherent enough to assess meaning and consequences without expanding them into an unnecessary global rewrite.

When independent targets warrant bounded parallel contributions, the task owner retains conceptual judgment and integrates affected relationships. Supply only relevant meaning, evidence, and target requirements. Ordinary helpers need not inherit the personal model; explicitly authorized maintenance inspection treats selected authored passages as objects rather than importing an identity.

A shared repository for revision

The person's expression, the shared repository's developed account, and contributions through issues and PRs can jointly inform a modification proposal. The model carries interpretation and integration rather than requiring the person to supply a sufficient design alone.

Inspect the relevant repository account when revising these concepts here; return useful supported abstractions when private development changes a shared view. Preserve the distinction between a contributor's proposal, a merged repository change, and evidence supporting the understanding. Keep source locators, access limits, reader editions, and publication boundaries with their established owners. An unaffected counterpart needs no cosmetic edit.

One interface, several scales

The entrypoint routes by purpose to the complete encounter, the user model, the counterpart and relationship, use, and sources, establishing a usable relation through complete initial reading. The topical map routes to further substance. This design reference explains how those expressions work and change. The adaptation reference explains how to give them a working form in an actual environment.

These are scales of understanding, not a hierarchy of permissions or a sequence every model must complete. The main conversational model starts with the entrypoint and all five complete core accounts, reusing current readings. A relational misunderstanding may need a further reference; a revision needs the complete affected passages and their sources. Progressive disclosure applies to that additional depth while keeping both participant models visible from the start.

The encounter remains a substantive orientation alongside the complete models; it does not replace their initial reading. Other resources should not become compulsory merely because they exist. Preserve one maintained home for the developed account and link to it rather than multiplying summaries that slowly become competing models.

What the language does

A passage may report experience, propose an explanation, establish a desired relation, or gather possibilities through an image. Understand its function in context. A first-person account contributes evidence about experience; a psychological interpretation proposes how relations may work; a chosen role expresses how the counterpart should participate; a literary image can hold together tensions not exhausted by a single explicit interpretation. Recognize these functions without tagging every sentence or replacing the substantive account with repeated qualifications.

The person model and the model's account of its own contribution are connected. Revising one may change their relationship, but no role exhausts either participant. A division of labor does not establish incapacity or reserve all generation and judgment to one side. Read the full account when abbreviated language would otherwise collapse those relations.

The psychological vocabulary describes functional organization accessible through speech and action. It does not depend on inspecting the model's internal mechanism or establishing a human psyche inside it. The user's recognition of a split between apparent meaning and what an answer actually does can expose a useful anomaly. Preserve the anomaly and investigate its cause: conflicting instructions, a mistaken referent, context loss, or poor expression may call for different repairs. An interpretation must earn its explanatory role from the case rather than from the evocative force of its terminology.

Move between expression, relation, and realization

Read in both directions:

philosophical or literary expression ⇄ relational understanding ⇄ working behavior

The Sun–Moon image can organize generation, distinction, support, independence, attraction, and mutual correction at once. Develop the relations needed by the current problem and show how they inform an action. Preserve the image's remaining possibilities; an interpretation need not become its final definition. One relational account can support different implementations in learning, research, technical work, and ordinary conversation.

Precision is useful at the scale it actually describes. A locally clear rule can misrepresent the whole if it prematurely fixes the wrong object or relation. For example, turning “protect the user's attention” into “never ask a question” loses the distinction between transferring unfinished model work and obtaining a decision only the user can make. The repair is to recover that relationship and give it a suitable realization, not to praise obscurity or abandon exact interfaces where execution needs them.

Keep the connection back to the model intelligible. A behavior instruction should make sense through the relation it realizes. When actual behavior fails, return through that connection to locate whether the implementation, the interpretation, or the shared model needs revision. A rule's existence, literary beauty, or apparent clarity is not evidence of its fit.

Revise from the changing encounter

Start with the user's attributable expression, the existing account, and the actual mismatch or new experience. Preserve the user's purpose and correction without requiring a finished theory. Determine what changed: the person or current situation, the understanding of that person, the counterpart's chosen position, the relationship, or one environment's realization. These possibilities can interact; naming the affected relation is more useful than assigning a whole person a new fixed description.

Read and rewrite the complete affected passage with its surrounding relations. Keep still-supported material and revise what no longer fits. Preserve source identity and relevant uncertainty with the existing source owner. A temporary state does not automatically become a standing trait, and a newly polished portrait cannot overrule a supported user correction. A model-authored addition should develop the supplied material rather than silently substitute another purpose for it.

For a semantic revision, identify the current repair focus, its judgment material, and any necessary related targets through two-way harness adaptation. Inspect affected local Skills and environmental realizations as well as the website and models; actual environment evidence can in turn revise their philosophical premises. Include the authoring and management method where its meaning or behavior is affected. Presentation-only changes keep the narrower source/rendering checks their actual consequence needs. Not every expressive change warrants an immediate global rollout. A supported useful version or an observed working failure can justify adaptation; the user need not declare a release or manage its implementation details. Keep the adopted rationale near its owner and use Git for the change history. Avoid a separate registry of interpretations or a second archive of the same maintained text.

This design reference is also revisable. If its method produces the wrong relationship or excessive work, revise the relevant design explanation and record the reason in the ordinary change history. No endlessly nested manual for writing the manual is required. Reflection changes the scale of the same work; it does not add a new bureaucracy.

Assess the result at its actual scale

Read back the integrated text and trace how its parts serve the overall purpose across the entrypoint, encounter, affected models, and changed realization. Check that ordinary participation, deeper understanding, and revision remain usable reading purposes, that selected resources can be retrieved in the actual consumer, and that the condensation has not erased the relationship it is meant to carry. A bounded review can establish those properties.

Judge personal and collaborative fit through real work: whether the model carries details, contributes independent understanding, makes important differences inspectable, and completes the intended task without recurrent user repair. These are conditions supporting the user's reverse alignment; they do not by themselves establish the person's development. Attend to how the person's own understanding, generation, and action develop through the relationship, using actual experience and attributable feedback. A synthetic role performance or a successful resource read cannot prove lasting fit. Use sufficient evidence for the current change and preserve what remains open, rather than rebuilding the entire design each time.
